description: Read-only. Which of an organisation's verifiers bill each review from its owner's Console credits (Pay for reviews), the price per review, and the three ways its chain owner turns it on, signs a new budget (default $1,000, per delegation) or turns it off: the org's settings page on Asks, the Decision Console (Billing › Pay for reviews), or Claude Code (`eval-oracle api review-billing enable`). Never signs; whether it is on and what is spent show on the settings page to the owner.

network.description: Which deployment: `mainnet` is the real network (real money); `testnet` is the sandbox (play money, a dry run).

name: review_billing_status
title: Pay for reviews: an organisation's status and how to turn it on
